section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section contains the header and date of the maamar for Shabbos Parshas Tazria, Rosh Chodesh Nissan 5725.
section.t: With the help of Heaven.
Shabbos Parshas Tazria,
Rosh Chodesh Nissan,

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section discusses the two interpretations of "a woman who conceives and gives birth to a male," linking them to the advantages of arousal from below and arousal from above.
section.t: "A woman who conceives and gives birth to a male"
and our Sages, of blessed memory, said:
"If the woman emits seed first, she gives birth to a male; if the man emits seed first, she gives birth to a female."
And the Alter Rebbe brings
(in Likkutei Torah, the discourse beginning with the word "Zeh")
that the philosophers explained
that the reason for this—that if the woman emits seed first she gives birth to a male—is because when the woman emits seed first, the man's drop comes last, and the upper overcomes.
And the Alter Rebbe says that their explanation is a great difficulty.
And he explains, as is evident from the simple language, that the birth of a male comes from the woman's seed
(and not from the fact that the man's seed comes at the end).
And it can be said
that this that he brings in Likkutei Torah also the explanation that the birth of a male is from the man's drop
(which comes last,
because the upper overcomes),
and moreover,
that he precedes this explanation to the explanation that the birth of a male is from the woman's seed,
it is
because "man" and "woman"
(in spirituality)
are the Holy One, blessed be He, and the Congregation of Israel,
for the Holy One, blessed be He, is called "Ish" (Man) and the Congregation of Israel is called "Ishah" (Woman).
And it is known regarding the matter of arousal from above and arousal from below,
that in each of them there is an advantage.
For the advantage in arousal from below is that the flow brought about through it is from the inwardness of the light,
and the advantage in arousal from above, in its own right, is that the flow is from a much loftier place that arousal from below does not reach there
(except that the flow from there is from the aspect of externality).
And it can be said
that from this are derived the two explanations of "a woman who conceives and gives birth to a male" in its simple sense.
For the explanation that the birth of a male is from the man's seed, that the upper overcomes,
is derived from the advantage in arousal from above,
and the explanation that the birth of a male is from the woman's seed is derived from the advantage in arousal from below.
And therefore he also brings the explanation that the birth of a male is from the man's seed
(even though in physicality,
this explanation is not in accordance with the conclusion),
in order to hint that there is also an advantage in arousal from above.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that in the month of Nissan, the emphasis is on the advantage of arousal from above, yet the conclusion emphasizes the advantage of arousal from below, as seen in the maamar "HaChodesh."
section.t: And it can be added,
that the portion of Tazria is read
(in some years)
in the month of Nissan,
whose theme is arousal from above,
and therefore he brings this explanation
(that the birth of a male is from the man's seed)
before the explanation that the birth of a male is from the woman's seed,
because in the month of Nissan,
the emphasis is on the advantage in arousal from above.
And this that the conclusion is that the birth of a male is from the woman's seed,
because after the giving of the Torah,
even in the month of Nissan,
the emphasis is on the advantage of man's service
(arousal from below).
And this is also understood from the maamar beginning with the word "HaChodesh" of the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory,
the baal hahillula of the 2nd of Nissan,
where he asks there
(at the beginning of the maamar)
"Why is service specifically with one's own power necessary, and what is the advantage in this? Are not the love and fear that come from above much higher?"
That this that he asks
(what is the advantage of service with one's own power),
even though in many discourses it is explained
(as above)
the advantage of arousal from below
(service with one's own power),
it can be said
that in the maamar "HaChodesh" the advantage of arousal from above is emphasized,
and therefore there is room for the question: what is the advantage of service?
But from this that this matter
(what is the advantage of service)
is only a question,
it is understood
that even in the month of Nissan
(the maamar "HaChodesh"),
in which the advantage of the flow coming from above is emphasized,
the conclusion is that there is
(also)
an advantage in service with one's own power
(arousal from below)
over the love and fear that come from above
(arousal from above).
And moreover,
that this matter
(the advantage of arousal from below)
is the primary advantage,
therefore,
the conclusion
(in Likkutei Torah)
is that the birth of a male is from the woman's seed,
the advantage of arousal from below.
